controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour or brightness.
controls.notes: No image of the photosphere is cast here (no resolved image of this star's surface is published in a form this pipeline can cast; see the investigation ledger). Neutral gray marks an unresolved surface; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
